# Create Images with AI

**Languages:** [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_zh.md)

Learn to create, edit, adapt, and check useful everyday images with ChatGPT.

[Start this course on AILesson](https://ailesson.io/courses/create-images-with-ai)

You may know what you want an image to do but not know how to draw it, edit it, or describe it in design language. ChatGPT can turn ordinary words and existing pictures into new visual drafts. The useful skill is not finding magic phrases. It is giving the image a clear job, checking what actually appeared, and deciding what still needs human judgment.

This Course builds that skill through three separate everyday cases. First, you create and refine a personal birthday image. Next, you edit a prepared desk photo while protecting details that should not change. Finally, you make a Game Night invitation, verify its visible words, and adapt it from portrait to square. Each case is complete on its own, while the same method becomes more demanding from one Stage to the next:

```text
Decide the purpose
  → describe the change, content, and boundaries
  → generate or edit a draft
  → inspect the visible result
  → compare it with the request
  → revise or choose an honest status
```

All people, event details, and room materials in the practice cases are prepared for the Course and contain no real personal information. The images shown are snapshots from real runs. Your live result may differ even when you send the same request.

ChatGPT can create and transform the image, but it cannot know another person's taste, measure a real room from this practice photo, confirm an address, or share an image for you. You remain responsible for checking visible text and details, confirming real-world facts, and deciding what to save or send.
